positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
▪ Under the guidance of Professor Iftekhar Ahmed, Engineering Department, I worked with a 4 person team using Python/Java to extract and scrape information from social media sites for analyzing data about performance enhancing drugs for research paper
▪ Gained valuable teamwork and collaboration experience as well as knowledge on planning, execution, and review process for research

positions.title: Software Testing Intern
positions.description:
▪ Designed and developed detailed instructions and tutorials on Verisilicon Software product - Acuity 2019
▪ Engaged in software development of their product VIP (Vision Image Processing), a chip that uses machine learning to identify the contents of pictures
o Migrated certain parts code from TensorFlow to Pytorch so that it is compatible with new UI system created in Python
o Ran tests using different pre-trained image processing models to test efficiency of the product

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
▪ Organized patient information from Veteran Affairs database of all veterans in the United States
▪ Collect and organize data for research on Exercise Oscillatory Ventilation (Vainshelboim, Baruch et al. “A method for determining exercise oscillatory ventilation in heart failure: Prognostic value and practical implications.” International journal of cardiology vol. 249
(2017): 287-291. doi:10.1016/j.ijcard.2017.09.028)
o Analyzed raw test data for correlation between breathing patterns and heart disease
